# rustinion_group_host_health (Resource)

Manages a group's host-health settings: the swap alert (swap_in_use) and the failed system services (systemd units, Windows services, launchd jobs, rc.d services) that never raise service_failed. Full-filesystem levels follow the group's disk alert levels (rustinion_group_alert_tuning). Destroying this resource puts the defaults back (swap alert on at 80%, no ignored services).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The group these settings belong to.

### Optional

- `ignored_failed_services` (List of String) Failed services that never alert: exact names (`apt-daily.service`), or a prefix ending in `*` (`user@*`). Default none.
- `swap_alert_enabled` (Boolean) Alert when swap use reaches swap_alert_threshold_pct. Default true.
- `swap_alert_threshold_pct` (Number) Share of swap in use that raises the alert, 0-100 (0 = any swap use). Default 80.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as group_id.
